Bled Institute for Leadership in Digital Transformation and AI (BILDAI) was established by the IEDC-Bled School of Management in partnership with Roche Slovenia. BILDAI is dedicated to harnessing the transformative potential of artificial intelligence and digitalization.

Prof. Igor Rudan from the University of Edinburgh is serving as the non-executive Director of BILDAI. The Business Advisory Board is chaired by Mr. Ulrik Nehammer, Chairman of ServiceNow, and the Scientific Advisory Board is led by Prof. Robert Sackstein of Harvard University. These boards are instrumental in guiding BILDAI's strategic direction and ensuring its alignment with industry and academic excellence.
